result.instructions: Tools for Clockify, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Clockify data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run clockify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clockify_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clockify_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. clockify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clockify_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Clockify user this API key belongs to: id, name, email, status, active and default workspace ids, and profile settings (time zone, week start, date/time format). GET /v1/user.

tools.name: clockify_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the Clockify workspaces you belong to: id, name, plan (featureSubscriptionType), subdomain, currencies and default hourly/cost rate. Use the id as workspace_id in other tools. GET /v1/workspaces.

roles.description: Only workspaces where you have one of these roles.

tools.name: clockify_list_users
tools.title: List workspace users
tools.description: List the members of a workspace: id, name, email, status and settings. Filter by name, email, status or project access. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/users.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

name.description: Only users whose name contains this text.

email.description: Only users whose email contains this text.

project_id.description: Only users with access to this project.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: clockify_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients of a workspace (id, name, email, address, currency, archived). GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

name.description: Only clients whose name contains this text.

archived.description: true = only archived clients, false = only active ones. Default: both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: clockify_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects of a workspace: id, name, client, billable, public, color, archived, duration tracked, estimate and rates. Filter by name, client, user, billable or archived. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

name.description: Only projects whose name contains this text.

user_ids.description: Only these users (projects these users are members of) (ids).

archived.description: true = only archived projects. Default: archived and active.

billable.description: true = only billable projects. Default: all.

hydrated.description: true = include more detail (custom fields, memberships, estimates).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: clockify_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: One project by id: name, client, billable, color, note, estimate, duration tracked, rates and memberships. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

hydrated.description: true = include more detail (custom fields, estimates).

tools.name: clockify_list_tasks
tools.title: List project tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of a project (id, name, status, assignees, estimate, duration tracked). GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/tasks.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

name.description: Only tasks whose name contains this text.

is_active.description: true = only active tasks, false = only done tasks. Default: both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: clockify_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags of a workspace (id, name, archived). GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

name.description: Only tags whose name contains this text.

archived.description: true = only archived tags, false = only active ones. Default: both.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: clockify_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List the time entries of one user (default: you), newest first: id, description, project, task, tags, billable and timeInterval (start, end, ISO 8601 duration). Filter by time range, project, task, tags or description. For totals across users use clockify_summary_report. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

user_id.description: User id (from clockify_list_users). Default: you. Other users' entries need an admin or manager role.

start.description: Only entries starting at or after this time (ISO 8601 with a timezone).

end.description: Only entries starting before this time (ISO 8601 with a timezone).

description.description: Only entries whose description contains this text.

hydrated.description: true = embed the project, task and tag objects instead of ids only.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: clockify_get_time_entry
tools.title: Get a time entry
tools.description: One time entry by id: description, project, task, tags, billable, rates, custom fields and timeInterval. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries/{id}.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

hydrated.description: true = embed the project, task and tag objects.

tools.name: clockify_get_running_timer
tools.title: Get running timer
tools.description: The timer that is running right now for a user (default: you), or running: false. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries?in-progress=true.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

tools.name: clockify_summary_report
tools.title: Summary report
tools.description: Totals of tracked time (seconds) and amounts for a date range across the workspace, grouped by up to 3 levels (default project → time entry), e.g. hours per user per project last month. Respects the filters. POST reports /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/reports/summary.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

from.description: First day of the report, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). On Clockify's FREE plan a report spans at most 31 days.

to.description: Last day of the report, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive).

billable.description: true = only billable time, false = only non-billable. Default: both.

description.description: Only entries whose description contains this text.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the dates are read in, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Default: your Clockify profile's time zone.

tools.name: clockify_detailed_report
tools.title: Detailed report
tools.description: Every time entry in a date range across the workspace (user, project, client, task, tags, description, start/end, duration in seconds, amount), with totals; newest first, paged. POST reports /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/reports/detailed.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

from.description: First day of the report, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). On Clockify's FREE plan a report spans at most 31 days.

to.description: Last day of the report, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive).

billable.description: true = only billable time, false = only non-billable. Default: both.

description.description: Only entries whose description contains this text.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the dates are read in, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Default: your Clockify profile's time zone.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: clockify_create_time_entry
tools.title: Log time or start a timer
tools.description: WRITE: add a time entry for yourself. With end = a finished entry (log time); without end = a running timer that starts at start (default now). A workspace with required custom fields may refuse it. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

start.description: Start time, ISO 8601 with a timezone. Default: now.

end.description: End time. Omit to start a running timer.

description.description: What the time was spent on.

task_id.description: Task id on that project (from clockify_list_tasks).

billable.description: Billable. Default: the project's billable setting (read from the project), else not billable.

annotations.title: Log time or start a timer

tools.name: clockify_stop_timer
tools.title: Stop running timer
tools.description: WRITE: stop the running timer of a user (default: you) at end (default now). Clockify answers 404 if no timer is running. PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

user_id.description: User id. Default: you. Stopping someone else's timer needs an admin role.

end.description: Stop time, ISO 8601 with a timezone. Default: now.

tools.name: clockify_update_time_entry
tools.title: Update a time entry
tools.description: WRITE: change a time entry's start, end, description, project, task, tags or billable. Only the fields you pass change: the entry is read first and every other field (custom fields included) is sent back as it was. The entry is rewritten (PUT) from a fresh read, so an edit made to the same entry in between (e.g. in the Clockify app) can be lost. A new project without task_id clears the task. GET then PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries/{id}.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

end.description: New end time (also stops a running timer).

task_id.description: New task id (on the entry's project).

tag_ids.description: New tag ids (replaces the tags; [] removes them all).

tools.name: clockify_delete_time_entry
tools.title: Delete a time entry
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently delete one time entry. It cannot be undone. DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries/{id}.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

tools.name: clockify_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project in a workspace (needs an admin or project-manager role, depending on workspace settings). POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

is_public.description: Visible to the whole workspace. Default false: the project is private (visible to its members only).

tools.name: clockify_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: add a task to a project. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/tasks.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

estimate.description: Time estimate, ISO 8601 duration such as PT1H30M.

tools.name: clockify_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: WRITE: add a client to a workspace. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.

tools.name: clockify_create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: WRITE: add a tag to a workspace. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (from clockify_list_workspaces). Default: your active workspace.
